AA-12 Gen 2 Unique.Description: The most versatile shotgun imaginable. It can fire almost any type of ammunition - provided you can find the right Endless Variant magazine, of course!
AA-12 Gen 2 Unique.Explanation:
AA-12 Gen 2 >Endless Launcher<
This unique variant can use ALL magazines from the Endless Variant and has stats similar to the Buckshot Launcher Variant type - massive fire rate and extremely low recoil

RFB Unique.Description: Please don't confuse the "Automatic" and "No-Scope" parts of the name. It doesn't perform automatic no-scopes... whatever that would even mean
RFB Unique.Explanation:
RFB >Automatic No-Scope<
This unique variant is missing scope slot, but has full auto fire mode with full ergonomics and can use a variety of 7.62x51mm magazines

VPO-215 Unique.Description: Watch your bullet strike the target without recoil throwing your aim into the clouds
VPO-215 Unique.Explanation:
VPO-215 >Recoiless Lapua<
This unique variant has minimal recoil and is chambered in .338 Lapua Magnum rounds

AK-103 Unique.Description: Turns out switching calibers is easier than switching identities...
AK-103 Unique.Explanation:
AK-103 >Russian Market<
This unique variant can be chambered in both .366 TKM and 7.62x39mm, with decreased recoil and increased ergonomics

MP5K-N Unique.Description: A perfectly disguised M4A1, now with authentic German aesthetics!
MP5K-N Unique.Explanation:
MP5K-N >Handy Assault Rifle<
This unique variant is chambered in 5.56x45mm and has massively increased ergonomics

Blicky Unique.Description:
"When you don't have damage, you need a lot of ammo"
~Sun Tzu - The Art of War
Blicky Unique.Explanation:
Blicky >Neverending<
This unique variant has enormous magazines, fires bullets at four times their normal muzzle velocity, has a fire rate of 9000 RPM and absolutely no recoil. Clearly this makes it a perfectly practical combat weapon. The tactical advantages are obvious. The enemy will surrender immediately. NATO probably banned it. Actually... maybe they didn't. Look, it's a toy gun, alright? Just have fun
